text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hype for today's Sprinters S. reaches an unexpected fever pitch and draws tons of people to the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is hyped up too. So much so that she's packed a huge lunch for the occasion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Except she's already had lunch for today! After deciding to save it for dinner, she gears up for the Mile Ch.!
